text: This was my third time working with Heather on a pet portrait and as with the last two, the finished portrait is simply magnificent. She did such a great job capturing each dog with such great detail. My husband and I are in love with the three portraits that are on display above our fireplace (we receive so many compliments on them, too!).

owner_reply.text: Joanna, I am thrilled you love them!! Thank you so much for the support over the last several years. It has been an honor to work with both you and your husband!
